description: This file contains functions and types related to managing and summarizing matrix thread contexts, including creating a resolver for thread context based on matrix events.

methods.name: truncateThreadStarterBody
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: summarizeMatrixThreadStarterEvent
methods.description: Generates a summary string for a matrix raw event, truncating long messages or providing type-based descriptions.

methods.name: formatMatrixThreadStarterBody
methods.description: Formats a string describing the root of a matrix thread, including sender info and optional summary.

methods.name: createMatrixThreadContextResolver
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous resolver function that retrieves and caches matrix thread context information based on room and thread IDs.
